title: .omne/skill.json
description: The declarations of a Skill package, format version 1. The behavior owner is SPEC.md of @omne-harness/skill-contract. Lengths count Unicode code points. The parser rejects these documents, and this schema does not express the rule: a formatVersion written as 1.0 or 1e0 (the lexeme must be 1); a text with a lone surrogate; a repeated key; a byte order mark; bytes that are not UTF-8; a document over the JSON budget.

formatVersion.description: The number 1, written with the lexeme 1. Any other value is declaration-format-unsupported.

dependencies.description: Required tools. An absent list is an empty list.
